svg.title: Tree scene · mountain base line
svg.desc: The bottom edge of the mountains as a 7-unit line in the lettering ink, under the ridge line on the single-colour and airtanker crests. Not part of the full-colour scene. Centred in the shared crest window (source artwork shifted 1.25, 1.62 units). Isolated from bc-ministry-primitives-v5/data/art.json → treeInner #tree-mountains (bottom edge). Original coordinates retained; only the viewBox is cropped. Reference-based reconstruction, not an official master.
